unexpectedErrorDescription: We encountered an unexpected error. Please try again or contact support if the problem persists.
popupPurpose: Teamcenter opens a separate sign-in popup to connect to the embedded Mendix application.
popupBlockedInstructions: Your browser blocked that popup. Allow popups for this site, then reopen the sign-in flow.
popupStepOpenSettings: Click the popup blocker icon in the address bar.
popupStepAllow: Select the option to always allow popups for this site.
popupStepContinue: Choose Continue below to reopen the sign-in window.
MISSING_CONFIGURATION: A Mendix application URL is required.
INVALID_URL: The Mendix application URL is invalid.
INVALID_PARAMETER: Mendix parameters must resolve to strings, numbers, or booleans.
CONTAINER_NOT_FOUND: Unable to find the Mendix application container.
SESSION_DISCRIMINATOR_ERROR: Failed to retrieve the session discriminator.
MENDIX_NOT_FOUND: Cannot reach the Mendix runtime at the configured URL. Check that the URL is correct and the runtime is running.
